تحتفروا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِرُوا (taḥtafirū) /taħ.ta.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# تُحْتَفَرُوا (tuḥtafarū) /tuħ.ta.fa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
